row.name: Miralukan Force Sight
row.effect: You can perceive the world through the Force in 360 vision, bypassing blindness, illusions, and normal darkness within 50 feet.

levels.name: Miralukan Force Sight
levels.description: The Miralukan species is a force sensitive humanoid race born without eyes, who perceive the world through the Force. This aids them in bypassing blindness, illusions, or even physical obstructions like smoke, darkness, or physical objects.
levels.requirements: Required Advantage: Force Sight (Miraluka Specialized Vision)
